// @path: src/app/actions/somewhere.ts
// @expect: endsWith
// The operator most likely to be forgotten when somebody writes this gate's
// list from memory. It becomes LIKE exactly as the other two do.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function byPostcodeSuffix(suffix: string) {
  return db.establishment.findMany({ where: { postcode: { endsWith: suffix } } });
}
